verdict.rationale: AvaTax exposes a fully documented public REST v2 API with SDKs across six languages, detailed method-level docs (CreateTransaction, CreateNexus, etc.), a free trial for API access, and even a first-party MCP server enabling AI-agent-native access to tax calculation, transactions, and nexus data. Missing for 10: no publicly discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec at standard paths (probe returned 404s) and no independent third-party corroboration beyond vendor docs.
